question: Relative burden after equal modest leave-on neat-oil dose on human hair.

global_anchor.observation: Marsh, Knowles and Simmonds: viscosity influences spread and felt heaviness; hair lubrication/surface coverage depend on applied level and spread.
global_anchor.limit: Mechanism only; no specialty-cohort sensory panel, no species/grade transfer and no PUFA-to-light rule.

method_limits: No standardized comparative human-hair heaviness study was retrieved for these sixteen exact oils.
Material values are physical-to-hair-film inferences, not direct hair measurements.
Skin lightness, shine, penetration, pre-wash results and finished-blend claims did not select a class.
Unknown is retained where no material-specific observation supports a direction; it is not medium.

ROSE_TDS.observation: Refined Rosa moschata seed oil TDS: liquid; density 0.900–0.950 g/ml; no viscosity.

KUKUI_TDS.observation: Exact Aleurites moluccana seed oil: cold-pressed/refined, liquid at ambient conditions; no viscosity.

BRAZIL_TDS.observation: Exact Bertholletia excelsa seed oil: cold pressed; material identity/processing confirmed. No hair burden method; skin absorption wording not used.

BRAZIL_PAPER_25C.observation: Primary ultrasound-extracted Bertholletia excelsa seed-oil study reports 32.5 mPa s at 25 C.

BRAZIL_PAPER_40C.observation: Primary hydraulic-press study reports 41.06 and 41.35 cSt at 40 C across two harvests; protocol/processing differs from the 25 C ultrasound study.

PASSION_PAPER.observation: P. edulis seed oil: liquid at room temperature; viscosity 28 cSt at 40 C.

PASSION_HAIR.observation: Exact ingredient supplier says hair application without weighing down; no dose/comparator.

PRICKLY_PAPER.observation: O. ficus-indica seed oil viscosity 0.0531 Pa s at 20 C; species-specific physical study.

TAMANU_PAPER.observation: C. inophyllum oil physical study: kinematic viscosity 40.05 cSt at 40 C; high FFA in this sample.

TAMANU_REFINING.observation: 2026 tamanu study reports dynamic viscosity falling from 98.667 to 42.9 mPa s after refining, with removal of resin/FFA/phospholipids; measurement temperature must be retained from its Table 1 before numeric comparison.

SACHA_PAPER.observation: P. volubilis seed-oil study reports 35.4 mPa s viscosity; grade/extraction can vary.

PLUM_TDS.observation: Exact Prunus domestica seed oil supplier lists low-to-medium viscosity; no test method disclosed.

RASPBERRY_PAPER.observation: R. idaeus seed-oil study measured approximately 22.3 +/- 1.45 mPa s near body temperature; extraction affected lower-temperature behavior.

COFFEE_TDS.observation: Exact C. arabica seed-oil TDS calls material a slightly viscous liquid; no numeric method.

CRANBERRY_TDS.observation: Exact cold-pressed cranberry seed oil producer specification: clear liquid, 40–60 mPa s at 25 C.

CAMELLIA_TDS.observation: Exact Camellia sinensis seed oil: refined/bleached/deodorized/winterized, described as light-to-medium viscosity; no disclosed test method.

SEA_SEED_REVIEW.observation: Sea-buckthorn review reports seed-oil viscosity of 44 +/- 0.5 (as cited in its source table); retain original-source/temperature limitation.

PEANUT_SPEC.observation: Refined Arachis hypogaea oil: 35.2 mPa s dynamic/39.0 cSt kinematic at 37 C; oil can thicken on air exposure and solidified material needs melting/mixing.

BROCCOLI_HAIR.observation: 100% cold-pressed exact oil page permits direct dry/damp hair use and says it does not weigh hair down; supplier claim without comparator/dose.

SEA_IDENTITY.observation: Fruit/seed is a combined declaration distinct from separate seed oil; no proportion or physical burden value recovered.

entries.rationale: Exact cold-pressed material is liquid at ambient conditions; light is a declared weak fluid-film proposal, not a skin-lightness transfer.
28 cSt liquid material plus exact hair guidance weakly support light; neither is a comparative hair trial.
The exact-species study measured 53.1 mPa s at 20 C. Relative to nearby light candidate physical anchors, light is the rough equal-dose film proposal; it is not a direct hair result.
entries.excluded: Silicone/alkane hair serum claims and skin descriptors.

entries.rationale: Unrefined tamanu measured 98.667 mPa s before refining versus 42.9 mPa s after; this supports a rich crude-material tendency through spread/coverage mechanism. Refined material is a medium/light alternative, so the generic INCI remains low confidence.

Exact-oil studies report 32.5 mPa s at 25 C and 41.06–41.35 cSt at 40 C across different extraction/harvest protocols. These flow observations support a light working tendency; medium remains the explicit protocol/grade alternative.
entries.excluded: Silicone-dominant finished-serum claim and skin descriptors.

entries.rationale: Exact processed material is a liquid at ambient conditions; light is a deliberately weak fluid-film tendency, not an inference from its fatty-acid profile.
entries.excluded: Alkane-led blend and rinse-out conditioner claims.

entries.rationale: 35.4 mPa s physical observation supports a tentative light equal-dose film hypothesis, not a hair sensory finding.
Exact supplier calls the material low-to-medium viscosity. Medium is the conservative central value, with light credible; supplier does not disclose method.
entries.excluded: Finished-formula no-weigh-down claims and skin descriptors.

entries.rationale: Exact oil physical study gives about 22.3 mPa s near body temperature, supporting a low-residual-film light hypothesis; extraction/temperature variability remains.
Exact TDS calls it a slightly viscous liquid; medium is a qualitative physical working hypothesis, with light credible and roasted/green processing unresolved.

Exact cold-pressed producer specification gives 40–60 mPa s at 25 C. Relative to nearby nonvolatile light physical anchors, this supports a light working film estimate; medium remains credible across grades.
entries.excluded: Polymer thermal-spray and rinse-off formula claims.

entries.rationale: Exact sinensis RBDW supplier describes light-to-medium viscosity; light is a weak working tendency and not an oleifera/japonica transfer.
entries.excluded: Oleifera/japonica transfer, multi-oil blends and skin claims.

entries.rationale: Exact 100% cold-pressed direct leave-on use and no-weigh-down supplier assertion support light, still without dose/comparator/manufacturer study.
entries.excluded: Silicone-dominant formula guides and silicone-alternative rhetoric.

entries.rationale: Exact refined material reports 35.2 mPa s/39 cSt at 37 C and temperature/aging thickening behavior, supporting medium rather than a generic default.
entries.excluded: Skin non-greasy copy and unrelated formulation viscosity.

entries.rationale: Combined declaration lacks fruit/seed proportion and no exact-composite physical observation was recovered. Medium is only a provisional operational test point, explicitly not an average or seed-leaning assertion.
entries.excluded: Fruit-only, seed-only and silicone blend claims.

entries.rationale: Seed-oil review reports viscosity around 44, with original source/measurement condition not recovered; this supports only a light rough film tendency and cannot inherit fruit or combined-oil behavior.
entries.excluded: Fruit/seed blend, fruit-oil claims and color descriptors.
